snippet.title: GOD HELP US ALL | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
God Help Us All is a fixed-camera survival horror game that merges the suffocating dread of classic horror with the brutal grit of the Wild West.

WISHLIST NOW!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1967440/God_Help_Us_All/

www.retrogig.com
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
